costAccountingFaults.conclusion: For HTTP, parser, or cost-cap failures after send, only success evidence contributes usage/cost. A body can contain finite positive usage.cost while global settlement records zero.

budgetStateMachine.synthesizedFaultConclusion: If the initial DUAL_RESERVATION_COMMITTED journal append throws, the global reservation has committed but execution has not entered the settle-finally region; this leaks a fail-closed reservation without network dispatch.

findings.title: Claimed 192+4 compiler closure omits three literal file inputs read by the inherited compiler
findings.impact: Each omitted byte input changes the inherited sourceClosure hash, inherited private semantic hash, and v4 private semantic artifact while the advertised compiler-closure commitment remains unchanged.

findings.title: Price-snapshot live entrypoint bypasses the three authorization flags
findings.evidence: The direct CLI guard invokes main(); main performs one models GET and two model-endpoint GETs without loading or checking protocol authorization. Static source has no authorization reference.
findings.impact: A direct command can cause three real external requests while liveExecutionAuthorized, hostileAuditPassed, and dispatchCommandPresent are all false.

findings.title: Defense-in-depth gap: parser ignores a coexisting message.tool_calls field
findings.impact: The required finish_reason=tool_calls negative case is correctly rejected. This separate provider-envelope condition is outside the sealed content-schema contract, but exact message-envelope hardening would reject it explicitly.

findings.title: One post-reservation pre-try journal fault can leave a fail-closed global reservation unsettled
findings.evidence: If the initial DUAL_RESERVATION_COMMITTED journal append throws, the global reservation has committed but execution has not entered the settle-finally region; this leaks a fail-closed reservation without network dispatch.
findings.impact: No network overrun occurs, but the global two-candidate reservation can be stranded and the private/global state pair is not durably coupled for that fault point.

findings.title: Post-send failure paths can settle finite positive billed usage cost as zero
findings.impact: HTTP-status, response-parser, and cost-cap failures do not persist response usage evidence; the final global settlement aggregates only success evidence and state.actualCostUsd, underreporting already-sent/billed calls.
